correctness.rationale: For out-degree-one synchronous firing on directed C_n, the four 0/1 chips at {0,1,d,d+1} translate by one step, yielding precisely n facets F_i={i,i+1,i+d,i+d+1}. For d≥3 and n≥2d+5, cyclic steps 1,d−1,d,d+1 are unoriented distinct; each unique (d+1)-diagonal is free in its tetrahedron, giving n free-triangle/tetrahedron collapses, then exactly n free-edge/triangle collapses. Residual triangles A_i={i,i+1,i+d}, B_i={i+1,i+d,i+d+1} have face vector (n,3n,2n); the quotient of plane-triangulated Z² by kernel(a+db mod n) is a nonsingular oriented torus, with each edge exactly twice and 6-cycle vertex links. Cup product on H1 of T² is nonzero, ruling out wedge-of-spheres. Independently rebuilt all firing facets and all 2n free-face deletions for 190 (d,n) cases (3≤d≤12, 2d+5≤n≤2d+23) and checked residual torus combinatorics. The proof for all allowed integers is the universal cyclic-step and lattice argument, not finite tests.
